description: Source file implementing utility functions for HTTP/2 adapter in quiche, including memory management, header processing, error code translation, data frame source handling, and logging.

classes.name: Nghttp2DataFrameSource
classes.description: Implements DataFrameSource for nghttp2 data provider, handling payload selection and sending.

methods.name: Nghttp2DataFrameSource::SelectPayloadLength
methods.description: Selects payload length for data frame, handling deferred, error, and EOF conditions.

methods.name: Nghttp2DataFrameSource::Send
methods.description: Sends data frame with specified header and payload length.

methods.name: Nghttp2DataFrameSource::send_fin
methods.description: Indicates if the frame source has finished sending.
